summary: OpenAI published a report describing and banning two clusters of ChatGPT accounts linked to PRC-origin covert influence operations targeting US debates about data center energy costs and tech tariffs.

practices.reason: The report describes OpenAI's internal process for detecting and banning inauthentic accounts, but offers no transferable detection methodology an outside team could apply.
practices.quote: we describe two clusters of ChatGPT accounts likely originating from China that we banned after they used our models in support of apparent covert influence operations
